svg.aria-label: The FastAPI backend in layers. The web server and Traefik call the API under /api/v1. Middleware wraps every request. Routes call core logic and the pure decision engine. The core reads and writes through a repository to ClickHouse, reads aerial photos from S3, and calls Claude for the AI chat. Three drawn-field endpoints are in an open pull request. The feedback endpoint and the cover calendar are not built.
svg.title: AgroCycle backend architecture
svg.text: AgroCycle backend: how a request is served
Solid green: built and merged. Amber: open pull request. Grey: external service. Dashed red: not built.
calls the API from the server;
api/main.py · everything under /api/v1, docs at the root
api/routes · 22 endpoints merged, 3 more in an open pull request
api/core and engine/ · no I/O except through the repository
pure Python, no I/O, no model: the same field and answers always give the same result.
Returns worth exploring, a comparison with caveats, or not enough evidence. Never a score, ranking or winner. Rules 2026-11-15.4.
